name: Salsa brass stabs and runs
desc: A horn section in Bb major: punchy sawtooth brass stabs land on the syncopated mambo accents over an I-vi-IV-V vamp (Bb Gm Eb F) while a unison run answers in the gaps. Filter blooms across 16 cycles; peak widens the voicings to add-9 chords, fires 16th-note unison runs and throws a dotted delay.
